captures.note: A promoted card followed by one verbatim result card, from the RENDERED DOM. The company is the <h3> under the title; the card has no a[href*="/remote-companies/"], which is what src/adapters/nodesk.ts:66 looks for. The container walk at :59 therefore keeps climbing until it swallows a neighbouring promoted card, and that card's company link is what gets stored - 26 of 51 rows had the right company, 18 were "Unknown" and 7 were a neighbour's.
